theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks (H + HK) is the prevailing narrative: rank 1, highest score, strongest durability bar (0.67), and decent breadth (0.692) — a coherent, staying-power trend rather than a one-name spike. The absolute-trend gate is the only validated leg, and Banks passes eligibility. Crowding is absent (z 0.93, not flagged crowded), so this is a clean trend-following lean, not a crowded-laggard hold.
